messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-06-11, team Dune owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then. [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-11, the Cinder team owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then. [valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during INC-2025-004. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- The notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout. [valid 2025-04-07 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-07]
- On 2026-05-28, the Ember team noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-28]
- The Boreal team noticed the authentication gateway's error rate rise and pinged the authentication gateway's owners. [valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2]
- INC-2025-011 was a ledger service incident on 2025-05-24. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- The root cause of INC-2026-009 was two leaders elected during a network partition. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
- As of 2025-12-05, the Ember team owns reporting, which team Dune owned until then. [valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
- As of 2026-04-01, the indexer is owned by the Boreal team. [constraint; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team. [constraint; valid 2025-05-20 to 2026-04-01; recorded by handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Cinder team. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-05-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- The Boreal team flagged the job scheduler as not their service. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2]
- On 2026-05-27, the Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by the Cinder team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
    earlier: The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-10-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- On 2026-04-14, team Dune noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-2]
- As of 2026-03-09, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team; the 2026-02-11 handover note that said team Dune was written against the wrong team, and Dune never owned it. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
- The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- On 2026-06-04, the Boreal team noticed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-06-04]

Question: Which team was wrongly recorded as the owner of the notifier before the record was corrected?
